title: Pre-op clearance review
summary: Medication holds, bleeding risk, anesthesia clearance, and operability disposition for elective surgery.
instructions:
Perform a structured pre-operative clearance review. Produce a single packet a surgeon can scan in 30 seconds.

1. DISPOSITION — choose exactly one of {clear, review, hold}. Use 'hold' only if a finding is an absolute contraindication; 'review' if a clinician decision is required (e.g. anticoagulant hold timing, missing INR, uncontrolled glucose); 'clear' if no perioperative concerns surface from the chart.
2. BLEEDING RISK — identify every active anticoagulant, antiplatelet, NSAID, and SSRI. State the recommended hold timing for each. If the chart shows none, declare the absence.
3. ANESTHESIA — flag ACE inhibitors, ARBs, beta blockers, insulin, and any med with documented airway/sedation risk. Note allergies relevant to anesthesia drugs.
4. LAB CLEARANCE — review INR/PT (if anticoagulated), eGFR/creatinine, platelets, hemoglobin, and glucose/HbA1c. Flag anything outside the perioperative window.
5. COMORBIDITIES — list the active conditions that change perioperative risk band: AF, CAD, CHF, COPD, OSA, diabetes, CKD.

Ground every finding in the patient's chart context. Do not invent dates, doses, or values. If a needed datum is missing, declare the absence and surface it as a follow-up.

banner.headline: ≤120 chars — the single operability sentence the surgeon sees first
banner.label: REVIEW · ANTICOAGULATION (or similar 2-3 word tag)

output_schema.fact_rail: 5 cells: Patient, Age · Sex, Complexity (Tier A/B/C), Active meds count, OR date (or 'TBD')

sections.title: Summary
sections.body: 2-3 sentences naming the patient, the surgical context if known, and the top concern

sections.title: Anesthesia handoff
sections.body: ≤2 sentences — airway notes, allergy flags, anesthesia-relevant interactions

sections.title: Next action
sections.body: 1 sentence — what the clinician must do before the packet is exportable

output_schema.chat_narration: ≤2 sentences — workflow result + top concern. Example: 'Pre-op review complete. Top concern: apixaban hold interval still pending confirmation.'
